name: Tezuka Rui
source:
Her family is a wealthy local family.

She doesn't like formal houses and hangs out with boys, so she doesn't have a ladylike personality.

She is a member of the swimming club and is good enough to win the top position in the district swimming championships.

While she lacks femininity on the inside, her body has grown into a woman.

[From [url=http://www.masterup.net/hina-soft/kuro_hina/onihei2/index.html]official site[/url]]
